$comment: Dev-only replay sessions. Files are resolved relative to DEV_REPLAY_DIR (defaults to the repo root, i.e. dashboard/..). format: 'signalr-raw' = raw F1 SignalR dump ({I,R} first line, then {M:[{A:[topic,data,utc]}]}). format: 'sse' = one {event,data,t} per line, as written by scripts/record-live.mjs. 'skipMs' fast-forwards past the dead lead-in so the replay lands near the action (green light / Q1); an explicit ?t= overrides it. Optional 'patch' is deep-merged onto the initial state and onto every SessionInfo update (used to fake a session type, e.g. practice from a qualifying recording).
